maya: heads up — I'm seeing the request id vanish when the OAuth refresh retry runs in the Node sampleapp. makes tracing almost impossible. :confused:

sam_chang: repro on staging or prod? any error traces? :eyes:

maya: staging first. quick repro: call protected endpoint, token expired -> middleware triggers refresh -> retry the original request. backend logs show no X-Request-ID after retry. first request had it.

ben-ops: could be an OpenTelemetry propagation / log hook ordering bug. our logging hook reads req id from context, but the retry may be using a fresh axios instance w/o propagated headers.

ciara_reliability: which SDK / sampleapp version? are we using the default retry interceptor or a custom one?

maya: sampleapp node v0.9.3, default axios retry (axios-retry). headers on incoming request: `x-request-id: req-1234`. but outgoing retry request headers in logs look like: `authorization` only.

maya: logs snippet:
```
INFO auth: incoming headers {"authorization":"Bearer abc...","x-request-id":"req-1234"}
WARN auth: token expired, triggering refresh
DEBUG http: outgoing retry request headers {"authorization":"Bearer def..."}
INFO proxy: handled /api/data without req_id
```

sam_chang: ok that matches propagation loss. two quick questions: 1) is our otel propagator installed before or after the logging hook? 2) does the retry happen inside the same async context?

ben-ops: ordering matters — propagator must run before logging/context readers. in express we typically do: `app.use(otelHttpMiddleware)` then `app.use(loggingMiddleware)`. if retry code creates a new request outside that context, headers won't be copied.

ciara_reliability: quick mitigation: add an axios request interceptor that reads `x-request-id` from the current context and injects it into outgoing requests (including retries). e.g. in Node: 
```js
axios.interceptors.request.use(cfg => {
  const id = logging.getReqIdFromContext();
  if (id) cfg.headers['x-request-id'] = id;
  return cfg;
});
```

maya: tried that — works locally. but we also hit a redaction rule that removes headers matching `/authorization/i` and (badly) collapses the header set when redaction runs, which loses x-request-id if the redactor rewrites header blob. filing a separate redaction bug.

sam_chang: ugh. so two issues: header propagation across retries, and redactor collapsing header map. both need fixes. can you open PRs?

maya: yep. PRs incoming: sampleapp patch to add axios interceptor + unit test, and a redaction change to preserve non-sensitive headers. PR links will be in the issue.

ciara_reliability: add an integration test for oauth refresh path that asserts `x-request-id` persists after retry. also add a quick doc note in devex-sdks about retry interceptor requirement.

maya: will do both. also leaving a short workaround note in staging runbook: `export FORCE_PROPAGATE_REQID=true` to enable interceptor at runtime. :memo:
